settings.script_path.label: Script · noshot.lua
settings.script_path.description: Leave empty to use the copy shipped with the plugin, or noshot on $PATH. Set it to drive a checkout somewhere else.
settings.sync_settings.label: Script · Own noshot's settings
settings.sync_settings.description: Writes the options below to ~/.local/state/noshot/50-noctalia.lua, so they also apply to Hyprland keybinds that never go through Noctalia. Turn it off to hand the options back to ~/.config/nothings/noshot.conf.lua.
settings.capture_delay.label: Panel · Delay
settings.capture_delay.description: Seconds the panel's "wait" toggle and the launcher's delayed capture wait for. Panel only, never sent to the script.
settings.record_target.label: Panel · Default recording source
settings.record_target.description: Which source is preselected when the recording tab opens.
settings.image_dir.label: Files · Screenshot folder
settings.video_dir.label: Files · Recording folder
settings.video_dir.description: Where recordings and replay clips are saved.
settings.name_format.label: Files · Name format
settings.name_format.description: strftime format for capture and recording filenames.
settings.browser.label: Tools · Browser
settings.browser.description: Opens the Google Lens reverse search.
settings.viewer.label: Tools · Image viewer
settings.viewer.description: Opens a capture from a notification action.
settings.ocr_lang.label: Tools · OCR language
settings.ocr_lang.description: Tesseract language code, e.g. eng, por, jpn.
settings.editor_cmd.label: Tools · Annotation command
settings.editor_cmd.description: Runs when a capture is annotated; {file} is replaced with the path.
settings.slurp_args.label: Tools · slurp arguments
settings.slurp_args.description: Passed to slurp for every region, window and monitor selection.
settings.recorder.label: Recording · Backend
settings.recorder.description: gpu-screen-recorder handles pause and the replay buffer; wf-recorder is the CPU fallback.
settings.quality.label: Recording · Quality
settings.fps.label: Recording · Frames per second
settings.fps.description: Frame rate for recordings and the replay buffer.
settings.replay_seconds.label: Recording · Replay buffer length
settings.replay_seconds.description: How many seconds the armed replay buffer keeps in RAM.
settings.audio_desktop.label: Recording · Desktop audio device
settings.audio_mic.label: Recording · Microphone device
settings.copy.label: Behaviour · Copy to clipboard
settings.copy.description: Whether a capture lands on the clipboard by default.
settings.save.label: Behaviour · Save to disk
settings.save.description: Whether a capture is written to the screenshot folder by default.
settings.freeze.label: Behaviour · Freeze the screen while selecting
settings.freeze.description: Uses hyprpicker to hold the screen still during a region or window selection.
settings.cursor.label: Behaviour · Include the cursor
settings.cursor.description: Whether screenshots include the mouse pointer.
settings.notify_actions.label: Behaviour · Notification buttons
settings.notify_actions.description: Adds open, edit, copy path and delete buttons to the saved notification.
settings.notify_timeout.label: Behaviour · Notification timeout (ms)
settings.notify_timeout.description: How long noshot's notifications stay on screen.
